It distinguishes the vanishing of the first nontrivial square of a quadric, refines the known rank-only enumerations, and exhibits a mathematically motivated finite-field arithmetic trichotomy from cubic-root geometry. The statement is a complete natural small-dimensional classification, not an arbitrary isolated coefficient.
